scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @gems/schemas && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:client && npm run build:ssr && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __nodeCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __nodeCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=server-dist/server.js --external:vite
